documents.title: National identity card (राष्ट्रिय परिचयपत्र) enrollment
documents.text: National ID card enrollment is free of charge at ward-level local government offices. Required documents: citizenship certificate, birth registration certificate, and a passport-size photograph. Biometrics (fingerprints, iris, photo) are captured during enrollment. The 11-digit national ID number is issued after verification. Enrollment is mandatory for citizens 16 years and above per the National Identity Card and Civil Registration Act 2076.

documents.title: Birth registration (जन्म दर्ता)
documents.text: Birth registration must be done within 35 days of birth at the local ward office, free of charge. Late registration requires a letter from the ward office and may need additional verification. Documents: hospital birth notification or ward recommendation, parents' citizenship certificates, and marriage registration certificate of parents where applicable.
